neighbours.label: ' eventually' / ' ultimately' (in the end, after a delay)
fire: The weeds grow slowly, but they will eventually choke the bed.
Costs take time to appear, but eventually they will rise.
Early excitement eventually fades at most startups.
Phones are cheap now, but ultimately the makers want us to pay.
Everyone gets tired of this town eventually.
The case will ultimately go to the high court.
She eventually found a job in a nearby town.
All of this ultimately depends on the weather.
quiet: The weeds grow slowly and they choke the bed.
Costs take time to appear and they rise in spring.
Early excitement is common at most startups.
Phones are cheap now and the makers want us to pay.
Everyone gets tired of this town in winter.
The case will go to the high court on Monday.
She found a job in a nearby town last week.
All of this depends on the weather.

notes: Card: ' eventually' x20, ' ultimately' x3, ' Eventually'. Output promotes ' accomplished', ' ready'. Probe: 0.53-0.75; plain versions 0.02-0.06.
